d: India and Nepal on Monday vowed to script a “golden chapter” in their bilateral partnership, signing multiple agreements across key sectors and unveiling a 24,000 crore Nepalese Rupee reconstruction package alongside a new cross-border rail link connecting Ayodhya and Janakpur. Addressing a joint media briefing after the talks, PM Modi announced a financial package of 24,000 crore Nepalese Rupees dedicated to Nepal’s post-earthquake reconstruction and broader development initiatives.
